Favor LAPD and PKPK for near-term upside; trim ARKO exposure. Watch for IDX green-energy index rebalancing to add liquidity.

Rotate into food-service and specialty retail sub-sectors with earnings momentum, avoid broad index exposure. Target 3-6 week horizon, set tight stops at 5% below entry given normal signal volatility.
